attempts.prompt:
Clean infographic diagram explaining a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline, flat vector, white background.
Elements: five rounded rectangular nodes connected left to right by thin arrows, each node with a small simple line icon above its label.
Node labels read exactly, in order: "QUERY", "EMBED", "VECTOR SEARCH", "RERANK", "GENERATE". A caption under the third node reads exactly "top-k documents".
Flow direction: strictly left to right, single horizontal row, arrows of equal length.
All labels spelled correctly, uppercase, generously spaced.
Palette: white #FFFFFF background, light grey #EDEEEE node fills, cool grey #CCD1CF borders, near-black text, one single blue accent for the arrows.
Plenty of whitespace, consistent stroke weight, no decoration.

Avoid: gibberish text, overlapping labels, rainbow colors, 3d bevel, drop shadow, isometric perspective, photographic elements.
attempts.critique: 라벨 다섯 개 QUERY EMBED VECTOR SEARCH RERANK GENERATE와 캡션 top-k documents가 모두 철자 정확하고 겹침이 없다. 화살표 길이와 노드 크기가 균일하고 아이콘이 단순하며 흰 여백이 넉넉하다. 다이어그램 장르에서 가장 잘 터지는 실패인 라벨 뭉개짐이 전혀 없다.
attempts.fix: VECTOR SEARCH만 두 줄로 접혀 다른 노드와 리듬이 어긋나니, 노드 폭을 넓혀 한 줄로 맞출 것.
